node.statement: Uniform amplified block analysis. Put e=rho+epsilon. For every n, write each X in M_n tensor B as X=sum_{j,k=1}^2 X_jk with X_jk=(I_n tensor Pi_j)X(I_n tensor Pi_k), let mu_n(X)=(X_jk), let Gamma_n be the direct sum of the four fixed amplifications gamma_jk,n, and let alpha_n((Y_jk))=sum_jk Y_jk. There are universal K_blk<infinity and e_blk>0, independent of n and all dimensions, such that the source and target block estimates in the refinements below hold; in particular alpha_n is a bijection when e<=e_blk.
